subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memorySearch.extraPaths ingest arbitrary JSONL raw message logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay in QMD/session-memory/converter/plugin workflows?
rationale: Current source and docs keep builtin extraPaths Markdown/multimodal-oriented, while widening raw-log ingestion changes sensitive memory visibility and file-format support.

options.title: Document Supported Alternative
options.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add Native JSONL
options.body: Implement line-aware JSONL support across discovery, chunking, watching, memory_get, docs, tests, and privacy guardrails.

options.title: Defer To API Design
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document Supported Alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has current blame on the central memory host/runtime boundary and already provided maintainer-side context on this issue.
